disposition.change: Section 14 rows for MSG-S5-001, MSG-S5-002, MSG-GEN-001, MSG-P4-002 and MSG-P7-003 now state the standard meaning and status from FSD S5 and FSD P4; MSG-S5-002 type set to Error; version-clash message left as Not specified.
disposition.note: Standard meanings found in FSD S5 Assets and auction v3 (VR-S5-009-1, VR-S5-011-1), FSD P4 Access and administration v5 (VR-P4-003-1, AC-EXC-P4-001-05, AC-EXC-P4-004-04) and PRD S5 FR-S5-019.

edits.old: | MSG-S5-001 | Error | The floor is {pct} of fair market value, below the {limit} this level may approve. | Declared; raised by the pricing slice, not by this one |
edits.new: | MSG-S5-001 | Error | The floor is {pct} of fair market value, below the {limit} this level may approve. | Declared; raised when a floor below the approver's limit is refused (FSD S5 VR-S5-011-1); raised by the pricing slice, not by this one |

edits.old: | MSG-S5-002 | Warning | The appraisal is from {date}, more than a year ago. Order a new one before pricing. | Declared; raised by the re-appraisal slice |
edits.new: | MSG-S5-002 | Error | The appraisal is from {date}, more than a year ago. Order a new one before pricing. | Declared; raised when a price is requested on an appraisal older than a year (FSD S5 VR-S5-009-1; PRD FR-S5-019 refuses the price); not raised by this slice |

edits.old: | MSG-GEN-001 | Error | Enter {field}. | The buy-back element, required field empty → 422 |
edits.new: | MSG-GEN-001 | Error | Enter {field}. | The buy-back element, required field empty → 422 (standard: required field empty, FSD P4 VR-P4-003-1) |

edits.old: | MSG-P4-002 | Error | You cannot {action} here. Your role does not include it. | 403 on both reads and on the step |
edits.new: | MSG-P4-002 | Error | You cannot {action} here. Your role does not include it. | 403 on both reads and on the step (standard: role without the right, FSD P4 AC-EXC-P4-001-05) |

edits.old: | MSG-P7-003 | Error | The action was not taken because the decision could not be recorded. Try again in a few minutes. | 409 on a failed decision record |
edits.new: | MSG-P7-003 | Error | The action was not taken because the decision could not be recorded. Try again in a few minutes. | 503 when the decision log store is unavailable and the decision cannot be recorded (FSD P4 AC-EXC-P4-004-04) |

edits.old: A payload that does not match the element answers 422 with MSG-GEN-001; a version clash answers 409 with MSG-P7-003 where the record is the cause.
edits.new: A payload that does not match the element answers 422 with MSG-GEN-001; a version clash answers 409 with Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-S5-E4032-CON-9).
